_readme: Hand-entered numbers. Update each one when its source publishes a new figure, change as_of, then push. Values in USD trillions unless 'unit' says otherwise.

stores.label: Real estate
stores.note: Homes, commercial property and farmland. Partly financed by debt, so it overlaps the debt row.

stores.label: Debt (all borrowing)
stores.note: Government, company, household and bank debt, including loans. Traded bonds are a smaller part of it.

stores.label: US stocks (estimate)
stores.source: FTSE Global All Cap: $103.6T total (31 Dec 2025) x US weight 61.91% (31 Aug 2026)
stores.note: Mixed dates, so this is a rough estimate. Counts only freely traded shares.

stores.label: Other stocks, developed + emerging (estimate)
stores.source: FTSE Global All Cap: $103.6T total minus the US estimate
stores.note: Mixed dates, so this is a rough estimate. Emerging markets are inside this number.

stores.label: Private assets in funds
stores.note: Private equity, private credit, infrastructure and similar funds.

gold_above_ground_tonnes.note: All gold ever mined. Gold value = this amount x the live gold price.

money_hand.label: China M2
money_hand.note: Update monthly from the PBOC financial statistics report.

money_hand.label: Japan M2
money_hand.note: Out of date. Update from the Bank of Japan Money Stock page.
